# Liquidity stress result (`liquidity-stress` v1)

How long an entity survives a liquidity stress, day by day.

**Group:** Liquidity · **Mnemonic:** `LST` · **Identifiers:** `LST-…` in `resultId`

Open one with `LST <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: liquidity-stress
version: 1
description: "How long an entity survives a liquidity stress, day by day."
match: { kind: liquidity-stress, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Liquidity · Liquidity stress result, id: $.resultId }
strip:
  - { label: Scenario, bind: $.scenarioName }
  - { label: Entity, bind: $.legalEntityName }
  - { label: Survival (days), bind: $.survivalDays, fmt: amount0, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Lowest position, bind: $.minimumPosition, fmt: signed0, tone: sign }
  - { label: Appetite (days), bind: $.appetiteDays, fmt: amount0 }
panels:
  - id: path
    kind: line
    title: Cumulative liquidity position (90 days)
    code: PATH
    key: F2
    rows: $.path
    x: day
    y: position
    fmt: compact
  - id: drivers
    kind: hbar
    title: Outflow drivers
    area: right
    rows: $.drivers
    label: driver
    value: outflow
    fmt: compact
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.legalEntity, 'legal-entity')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
